questions.prompt: Which of the following statements accurately describes the impact of Modified Newtonian Dynamics (MOND) on the observed 'missing baryonic mass' discrepancy in galaxy clusters?

choices.A: MOND postulates the existence of fuzzy dark matter.
choices.B: MOND increases the discrepancy from a factor of 10 to 20.
choices.C: MOND explains the mass is in the form of neutrinos and axions.
choices.D: MOND reduces the discrepancy from a factor of 10 to about 2.
choices.E: MOND eliminates the missing mass entirely.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is an accurate definition of dynamic scaling in self-similar systems?

choices.A: Evolution of self-similar systems with time-dependent similarity.

choices.A: Axioms form the foundation and help derive theorems using proof theory.

choices.C: Axioms are redundant and can be derived from other statements.
choices.D: Axioms are used for experimental validation.
choices.E: Axioms prove statements are true irrespective of real-world validity.
